notes.title: Bratty Bottoms 2, Page is live now!
notes.content:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44992010/acec3ccee7975363d234b06978c38e366aa8086a.png

Add to your wishlist! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4017780/Bratty_Bottoms_2/

Bratty Bottoms 2, is a slice-of-life roommate visual novel with flirty banter, light comedy, and branching relationships. After moving to the city, you find yourself sharing an apartment with the bossy Chloe and her best friend Sophia. Daily choices, routines, and conversations will shape how your bond with them grows, whether it’s friendship, rivalry, or something deeper.

Genre: Visual Novel + Slice of Life + Roommate Romance

Setting: Shared city apartment

Main Role: A newcomer starting fresh in the city, looking for connections and new friendships

Core Loop:

 Spend time with Chloe and Sophia across different times of day
 Make dialogue choices that affect trust, tension, and affection
 Balance routines, house rules, and personal boundaries
 Unlock special story events through growing relationships


Romance Paths:

Chloe: A bratty, teasing “boss” who hides a softer, protective side 
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44992010/cbc16c1bf73543690f3434cc89b9303674af6baa.png

Sophia: Playful, shy, and warmhearted, learning to open up while relying on Chloe’s support
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44992010/11646ef21f2149c1d51712b6e5eaceb989837c39.png


Discord:

https://discord.gg/48pssxQPEm


Thank you

notes.title: GET READY! Only 5 DAYS LEFT UNTIL DELIVERY DAYS RELEASE!
notes.content:
Delivery Days 
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44992010/df7b9824fda007ed68782063bcd6c7dff08aca8c.png
Releasing on 22nd Aug,

Sometimes the simplest encounters can change everything.

In Delivery Days, a visual novel about chance meetings and unexpected bonds, you play as an overworked man who begins to find warmth and connection through the people who step into his life—one knock at the door at a time.

Order food, request help, or simply open the door—and you might find more than you expected waiting on the other side.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3860730/Delivery_Days/

Add to your wishlist!

Meet the Characters

Mika – The Food Delivery Girl
Bright, charming, and full of playful energy, Mika is a delivery worker who hides her softer side behind her cap and uniform. When her routine visits turn into something more personal, the line between casual deliveries and heartfelt moments begins to blur.
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44992010/5ec6a265a1ab4e971af466947398042f4f45adbc.png

Rika Akiyama – The Nurse
Elegant, gentle, and carrying the grace of maturity, Akiyama arrives when Yuuto falls ill from overwork. What begins as a professional check-up slowly grows into something warmer, though her past and vulnerabilities may complicate the bond you share.
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44992010/6fbaf2d47f93935a2fefc4f621756cf6ba329200.png
Features


 A modern-day romance visual novel with multiple branching routes.
 Experience different stories depending on who you open your heart to.
 Slice-of-life warmth mixed with emotional twists.
 Choices that determine your relationships and endings.
 Will you keep things casual, or let your heart get carried away with every delivery?
